images.caption: STATSports × InsideTracker concept: a squad-to-athlete workflow connects training load with blood, wearable, and wellness signals, then surfaces individualized recommendations and retesting. The storyboard uses fictional athletes and illustrative data.
H-E-B partner-experience prototype, tracing a journey from connecting lab results to a personalized grocery plan, Curbside cart, recipes, and an AI assistant, with follow-up testing closing the loop.

Kroger Health / OptUP concept: reframing an existing nutrition score around an individual’s biomarkers, then carrying that context through product recommendations, shopping, and follow-up results within the grocery app.

Peloton × InsideTracker prototype storyboard: connecting lab results and wearable data to a proposed 90-day training plan, post-workout guidance, and progress review. Visual cues guide viewers through the interactive demo.
myHealth prevention-plan concept: existing laboratory results are organized into a clear focus area, prioritized lifestyle recommendations, and a retesting timeline within the patient portal.

Genesis Demo Studio library concept, organizing partner prototypes by status, persona, template, and deployment address. The proposed shared workspace makes a growing body of exploratory work easier to navigate and reuse.
Genesis template-selection concept: start from scratch, adapt an existing demo, or reuse a journey pattern across fitness, grocery, wellness, health platforms, and professional sports.
Genesis partner-setup concept: configuring a prospective partner’s identity, category, and visual language from brand assets and reference screens, with a running summary of the proposed demo.

Genesis persona and dataset selection concept. The proposed workflow pairs science-maintained personas with de-identified cohorts to keep biomarker scenarios, user needs, and demonstration narratives aligned.

Genesis flow-preview concept: review a branded member journey alongside presenter notes, revise individual screens or request changes in natural language, and approve the flow before building the click-through prototype.
